_comment: The hub's registry. To add a new learning site, add one object here and deploy — the homepage and dashboard pick it up automatically. 'stats' read from Supabase tables (agg: count | sum | avg | distinct) filtered to the signed-in user (user_id). 'lastActive' drives the 'Continue where you left off' card and card ordering.
